description: This file defines `RecyclingBitmapDrawable`, a subclass of `BitmapDrawable` that manages reference counts for display and caching states, and recycles its bitmap when no longer in use.

classes.name: RecyclingBitmapDrawable
classes.description: A specialized BitmapDrawable that tracks whether it is being displayed or cached, and recycles its bitmap when no longer needed.

methods.name: setIsDisplayed
methods.description: Increments or decrements the display reference count and updates usage state accordingly.

methods.name: setIsCached
methods.description: Increments or decrements the cache reference count and updates usage state accordingly.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Checks if the drawable is no longer in use or cached and recycles the bitmap if appropriate.

methods.name: hasValidBitmap
methods.description: Checks if the bitmap is non-null and not already recycled.
